name: InfluxDB
short_desc: Time-series database for metrics and events
author: InfluxData
description: InfluxDB is an open-source time-series database designed to handle high write and query loads. It is widely used for storing metrics, events, IoT sensor data and real-time analytics, and integrates with Telegraf, Grafana and many home automation platforms. This app bundles a maintenance sidecar that can provision a configurable multi-stage downsampling pipeline (buckets + Flux tasks) and takes automatic compressed backups.

form_fields.label: Admin API token
form_fields.hint: Used by the maintenance sidecar for retention tasks and backups. Auto-generated on fresh installs; for existing installs replace it with an all-access token created in the InfluxDB UI.

form_fields.label: Retention stages
form_fields.hint: Empty = disabled. Semicolon-separated <age>:<resolution> stages, last stage may be <age>:drop, e.g. 30d:1h;2y:1d;10y:drop. WARNING: enabling sets the retention of the initial bucket to the first stage age — older raw data is deleted.

form_fields.label: Backup interval (hours)
form_fields.hint: Compressed backups via influx backup. 0 disables backups.
